stories.new_fact: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called for a more balanced U.S.–China trade relationship ahead of talks.
stories.new_takeaway: Operational planning should focus on named trade measures and contract exposure, not negotiating rhetoric.
stories.why_now: The AP report is dated November 10 and concerns current talks.
stories.previous_coverage: The previous seven scripts did not cover this U.S.–China trade framing.
stories.uncertainty: No new tariff schedule, agreement, or effective policy date is reported.
stories.watch: Joint statement, tariff or licensing action, sector measure, or written trade treatment.

stories.new_fact: Four residential rezoning requests for about 195 acres are reported as heading to the November 12 Development Commission hearing.
stories.new_takeaway: The recommendation-stage record exposes dependencies and conditions before an entitlement is mistaken for completed housing.
stories.why_now: The group of cases was reported November 10 ahead of the posted city hearing.
stories.previous_coverage: No prior episode grouped these current rezoning cases.
stories.uncertainty: A hearing and recommendation do not establish Council approval, financing, engineering completion, or construction.
stories.watch: Staff material, recommendation, conditions, ordinance filing, or Council action.

stories.new_fact: Pennymac updated conventional and government LLPAs for Best Efforts commitments taken on or after November 10.
stories.new_takeaway: Commitment-date controls and current pricing matrices matter more than a generic rate recap for affected correspondent workflows.
stories.why_now: The announced pricing update became effective November 10.
stories.previous_coverage: No prior episode used this commitment-pricing notice.
stories.uncertainty: The bulletin does not determine an individual borrower’s price or apply to every execution channel.
stories.watch: Detailed pricing artifacts, product guidance, commitment exceptions, or disclosure implications.

stories.date_exception: Explicit seven-day specialist update: a November 6 operational implementation disclosure was previously unselected and is relevant to internal AI delivery decisions; it does not count toward the fresh-story minimum.
stories.new_fact: Deutsche Bank described a unified AI development environment using Google Cloud tools and common development tools and controls.
stories.new_takeaway: A common delivery environment is evidence of a route to build, not evidence that a customer-facing or high-impact workflow produces a result.
stories.why_now: It is a within-seven-day implementation update with a concrete internal workflow implication.
stories.previous_coverage: The November 8 research considered but did not select a Deutsche Bank source; no prior script made this takeaway.
stories.uncertainty: The bank discloses no before-and-after productivity, production-volume, error, customer, or independent-test measure.
stories.watch: Named production application, measured baseline comparison, failure evidence, or customer outcome.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Added Deutsche Bank lane-seven/lane-eight announced shared AI development environment row; company claim and no disclosed operational metric.

stories.new_fact: Anthropic announced Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 as new versions positioned for technical work.
stories.new_takeaway: Availability is not a local performance finding; version changes require task-level comparison before a regulated workflow switches models.
stories.why_now: The named versions were announced November 9.
stories.previous_coverage: No prior episode used this version release.
stories.uncertainty: The source’s capability description is a lab claim and does not itself provide the listener’s local task baseline.
stories.watch: Model card, evaluator results, version comparison, cost and latency data, or independent replication.
stories.frontier_bar: new capability with a named version release

stories.new_fact: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its proposed IPO; AP reported a potential valuation around $1.3 trillion.
stories.new_takeaway: The offering is a market test of valuation and disclosure assumptions, not a completed value or a verdict on product utility.
stories.previous_coverage: No prior episode covered the roadshow as a public-market financing test.
stories.uncertainty: Pricing, demand, timing, valuation, and the final offering remain unsettled.
stories.watch: Prospectus, pricing range, investor demand, offering terms, or comparable AI-stock reaction.
